hook: Kya tumne us raat ki train dekhi?
feedback: Great atmosphere and pacing for a short Instagram reel. The Kolkata Metro setting feels authentic and modern. Cut 1 uses a strong flash-forward hook. To improve, ensure the emotional bond between Asha and Kabir/Veer is established a bit faster in the first 10 seconds to maximize audience retention.
lines: Kya tumne us raat ki train dekhi?
Raat ke dhai baje platform khamosh tha, hawa thandi thi.
Asha akeli khadi thi, yaar, darr lag raha tha.
Uski aankhen chamak rahi thin, koi purani yaad sata rahi thi.
Intercom se aawaz goonji, 'Asha, sun rahi hai kya yaar?'
Kabir ne lamp aage badhaya, boli, 'Bhai, platform safe nahi hai.'
Asha ka haath phone se chipka, tuta bangle zameen par gir gaya.
Veer ne dheeme se kaha, 'Bhai, chalo, train aa gayi!'
Saans phoolne lagi, dil ki dhadkan jaise tham gayi ho.
Lamp bujh gaya, thanda sannata chha gaya.
Intercom par Kabir ki aawaz aayi, 'Asha? Tum kahan ho?'
Asha ne kaampte hue phone uthaya, 'Tu kaun hai bhai?'
Kabir ki aankhon mein darr tha, 'Main station ke bahar hoon.'
Kya tumne us raat ki train dekhi?
